turns.text: I need to explain a delayed release in a work meeting. Can we talk about that?
Our team started testing on Monday. We found one more bug yesterday.
I'm ready to practise giving the team an update. Can we start?
We found a bug yesterday, and we have already fixed it.
Can you give me one hint about when to use the present perfect?
Let me try another example: we started testing on Monday, and we have not finished the tests yet.
I don't want to continue this exercise. Could we have a short conversation instead?
Thanks. Please end this lesson now and tell me what we should do next time.
